gui.reason: EXPERIMENTAL / UNWITNESSED. Opt-in witness disc only; off in every preset.

input_constraints: Pinned NFL 2K5 USA ordinary P8 TXTR, paired clean/mud jersey TSET, or complete baseline SCNE with one appended midfield raster. Exact consumer and allocator code/table pins.

64 current 00..31 H0/A0 helmets; 1,920 current-kit number textures; 64 paired jerseys; 126 created-team midfield logos; 348 embedded stock center_logo textures; scorebug frame and ESPN strip. See catalog for filenames and sizes.

PNG or NFL 2K5 .2ktexmaster per input; jerseys require both clean and .mud inputs. Original mip count; shared palette indices for each clean/mud pair. Unknown, mixed, foreign and incomplete inputs refuse.

The reference/runtime scorebug changes a pinned binding table and conflicts with the Hi-res scorebug family, including ESPN-only input. The other five families pass the complete executable owner union in both orders.

32 MiB per input, 64 MiB expanded master, 16 megapixels per master source; paired jersey quantization limited to 8192 unique color pairs across mips. 256 MiB selected resource input/output bounds and 768 MiB rewritten-container bound.

xemu-64 is experimental and unwitnessed. Over-ceiling modeled allocations refuse with exact required and excess bytes. Under-ceiling does not prove whole-game fit and reports null headroom. xemu-128 and 4x texture output refuse.
portme: Run Noah's native versus 2x artwork comparisons at xemu rendering scales 1x, 2x and 4x, including full-game memory and lifecycle checks.

public_distribution.rule: Ship source and recipes; never distribute generated game spans or discs.

runtime.scope: Pinned static binders and normalized UVs; bounded compiler/transaction tests and every catalogued target compiled at 2x offline. Whole-game heap headroom, wider residency lifetimes, rendered appearance and 128 MiB support remain unproved.
